exchanges.csv.license: Crocodile research matrix (this repository, Apache-2.0); weekend/close of library rows from exchange_calendars (Apache-2.0).
exchanges.csv.notes: 172 operating MICs from the research matrix, joined to the ISO 10383 snapshot. Weekend and close of the 68 rows with xcal_code come from exchange_calendars (XNAS->XNYS and XTSX->XTSE via the library alias table; XSHE, BJSE, XCNQ and XNGM via curated sibling codes, xcal:sibling); curated rows come from curation.csv; all other rows are SAT,SUN with weekend:unverified. Sanctioned rows follow sanctions.csv (default-closed). Quote scale 2 only for XJSE, XLON and XTAE.

grammar_google_finance.csv.notes: Rule: the google_finance_code the matrix records with HTTP 200 for each market, plus the NASDAQ and NYSE connector rows copied from the existing Google Finance connector, which were not re-probed.

grammar_tradingview.csv.license: Exchange codes observed in TradingView scanner responses; TradingView terms not read (grey source, spec 0); codes are identifiers, no market data is shipped.
grammar_tradingview.csv.notes: HSTC's measured codes are HNX (primary) and UPCOM (segment XHNX, demoted to 0) since the 2026-11-11 sweep; codes the sweep saw without an unambiguous MIC stay unmapped.
grammar_tradingview.csv.source: curated from tests/core/markets/fixtures/tradingview_probe/*.json (scanner responses 2026-11-08, and the 2026-11-11 market sweep for the rows added then)

grammar_yahoo_chart.csv.license: Derived from the Crocodile research matrix (this repository, Apache-2.0); symbol spellings observed on Yahoo/Google pages, whose terms restrict automated use (spec 3.10a); not reviewed further here.
grammar_yahoo_chart.csv.notes: Rule: one row per suffix in symbol_format whose example the matrix records with an HTTP 200 status (verified or status_only); listed and failed rows are skipped, US rows are unsuffixed with the us_class_dash rule, and .KQ is the segment XKOS of XKRX.

iso4217.csv.license: List one published by SIX as ISO 4217 maintenance agency; only code, minor unit and name derived; terms not reviewed in this task.
iso4217.csv.notes: Derived from list one. Excluded the 13 codes with minor unit N.A.: XAG, XAU, XBA, XBB, XBC, XBD, XDR, XPD, XPT, XSU, XTS, XUA, XXX. Kept the 10 fund codes (IsFund=true) because they denominate real instruments: BOV, CHE, CHW, CLF, COU, MXV, USN, UYI, UYW, XAD. Withdrawn codes BGN, HRK, ZWL and SLL are absent because list one no longer carries them.
